fields.title: 6. Corrections and resolutions from the previous round
fields.md:
- **No corrections** — The figures and verdicts of Round 9 (11/3) stand as they were. The source-side after-the-fact revision of the 11/2 trading volume (Section 2) is a record, not a correction (source: `reports/2026-11-03-event.md`).
- **No resolutions** — The checkpoints for T9, T10, T7 and T8 have all yet to arrive (as of 11/3 US time). No new filings on EDGAR (source: [EDGAR filing list](https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001181412.json), retrieved 2026-11-04).
- **New open items**: ① the original complaint (neither PDF can be rendered by the tool), the case number, the assigned judge, and whether a preliminary injunction has been sought ② Musk's SGE status (not disclosed by the Department of Defense) ③ the original text of the 9/30 memo and the Department of Defense press release (403 — confirmed only through reprints) ④ the full list of all 21 committee members (MITRE) ⑤ the Department of Defense's official response (whether a charter has been filed) ⑥ the wording on Musk's government role in 10-K Item 1A ⑦ the measurement layer's share — whether the news monitor's queries include a 'CEO government role/conflict of interest' type · court records (PACER/CourtListener) are still not a monitored source (source: Section 1).
